app.title: Guardian for a Day
app.tagline: Design the sensor network of a real monument, then see what the ARGUS experts did.
app.loadError: Sorry, the game data could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
app.footer: Real data from the ARGUS project (snapshot of {date}). Story texts, sensor costs and scores were written by the game team.
steps.label: Progress
home.intro: Old buildings are in danger from water, weather, insects and people. Today you choose the sensors that watch over one of them. Then you find out what the ARGUS experts really installed.
home.how1: Read the story of the monument.
home.how2: Spend your coins on sensors that can warn us about three dangers.
home.how3: Compare your choices with the real ARGUS sensors.
home.how4: Replay a real alarm from 2026: would your sensors have noticed?
home.levelHelp: Experts rated every danger at this monument, from Low to Catastrophic.
story.mission: Protect the monument from three dangers. You have {coins} to spend on sensors.
mission.heading: Build your sensor network
mission.done: Done! Show me what ARGUS did
mission.needOne: Add at least one sensor first.
reveal.heading: What ARGUS really installed
reveal.intro: ARGUS has {n} instruments at this monument. Some sit together on one device and measure several things at once.
reveal.satelliteNote: One of them is not on the building: it is a layer of satellite images.
reveal.tableCaption: Your sensors next to the ARGUS sensors
reveal.noWrong: There is no single right answer. The real experts had to choose too. Every difference is a good question to talk about.
reveal.promptMany: ARGUS installed {n} × {name}. Why might one not be enough?
reveal.promptOnlyYou: You chose: {name}. ARGUS did not install one here. What would it add?
reveal.promptOnlyArgus: ARGUS installed: {name}, and you did not. Which danger could it be watching?
event.heading: A real alarm
event.timesBelow: That is only {pct}% of the limit.
event.question: Would your network have noticed?
event.yes: Yes! It would have been caught by: {names}.
event.no: No. To catch it you needed: {names}.
event.source: Source: ARGUS alarm, rule {rule}, event record {ids}.
event.dataNote: Real data from August and September 2026. Some sensors showed impossible values, so we left those alarms out.
event.flatNote: This sensor showed almost the same value for many days. Experts would also check that the sensor itself works: sensors can break too.
event.none: There is no usable real alarm for this monument yet.
score.heading: Your score
score.efficiency: Coins spent on helpful sensors: {useful} of {spent}
score.noSensor: No sensor can warn us about this. It needs people: guards, visitors, restorers.
score.communityLocal: Saved anonymously, only on this device. No names are stored.
score.communityCount: Games at this level on this device: {n}
score.communityTop: Most chosen sensor: {name} (in {pct}% of games). ARGUS installed {argus} of them here.
score.communityFirst: Nobody has played this level here before you. Your choices are saved for the next players.
